What does it take to build a future that works for everyone?
As a Gates Foundation Goalkeepers Champion, Debjani Ghosh has spent her career thinking about how innovation can create meaningful, inclusive change.
In this conversation, she looks at one of the defining questions of our time: how can India shape an AI future that keeps people at the centre?
From building technology that understands India’s cultures and nuances, to making innovation trusted, accountable and designed for scale, Debjani reflects on what India’s digital journey can teach us about the next frontier of technology.
